concept: Lambda: provisioned concurrency vs cold starts
tests: How to eliminate cold-start latency for a latency-sensitive Lambda API with minimal effort.
expected: Provisioned concurrency keeps pre-initialized execution environments. Triggers: "cold starts", "latency spikes", "latency-sensitive endpoint".
why_not: Timeout does not affect initialization; more memory speeds up execution but does not reliably eliminate cold starts; moving to EC2 — more operational overhead.
